follow-up time: From 24-28 weeks of pregnancy to delivery
cohort: 608 pregnant women with hyperglycemia during pregnancy, from the Obstetrics Department of Shengjing Hospital Affiliated to China Medical University between June 2019 and December 2021.
finding: Higher FPG-CV was independently associated with an increased risk of low birth weight, preterm birth, and preeclampsia in pregnant women with hyperglycemia.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome, with higher FPG-CV associated with low birth weight
